name: Aurora Phoenix
clause: Whenever you cast a spell with cascade, return ~ from your graveyard to your hand.

needs.proposedSignature: `Filter.withNamedKeyword?: string` — a keyword-ability predicate that accepts the named keywords living outside the `Keyword` enum (cascade, storm, flashback, kicker, …), answered from the object's `CardDef` flags and from any grant in effect; plus `TriggeredAbility.functionsFrom?: 'graveyard'` so `queueTriggers` scans graveyard cards that declare it
needs.semantics: "Whenever you cast a spell with cascade, return ~ from your graveyard to your hand" needs both halves: `Filter.withKeyword` is typed to the `Keyword` enum, which has no `cascade` (cascade is `CardDef.cascade`, not a member of `keywords`), and the trigger has to work while the card is in the graveyard, which only the `anthem` static's `whileInGraveyard` flag approaches today (`triggerPerms` scans battlefield permanents plus registry trigger sources).
needs.clause: Whenever you cast a spell with cascade, return ~ from your graveyard to your hand.
